title: Groww SIP schemes in these notes
facts: These notes cover five Groww mutual-fund SIPs and Groww Stock SIP. Figures were copied from the Groww pages on 4 Nov 2026. Past returns are what those pages printed. They are not a forecast. These notes do not say which scheme to buy.
NAV on these pages is the price of one unit on the date shown.
Groww Large Cap Fund Direct Growth: equity large cap, very high risk, NAV 03 Nov 2026 ₹51.52, header size ₹132.67 Cr, expense 1.76%, minimum SIP ₹500, exit load 1% if redeemed within 7 days.
Groww Multicap Fund Direct Growth: equity multi cap, very high risk, NAV 03 Nov 2026 ₹12.23, header size ₹1,687.35 Cr, expense 0.99%, minimum SIP ₹500, exit load 1% if redeemed within 1 year.
Groww Small Cap Fund Direct Growth: equity small cap, very high risk, NAV 03 Nov 2026 ₹12.36, header size ₹965.96 Cr, expense 1.01%, minimum SIP ₹500, exit load 1% if redeemed within 1 year.

Groww Nifty Smallcap 250 Index Fund Direct Growth: equity small-cap index, very high risk, NAV 03 Nov 2026 ₹11.39, header size ₹135.84 Cr, expense 0.63%, minimum SIP ₹500, exit load 0.25% if redeemed within 7 days.

Groww Liquid Fund Direct Growth: debt liquid, moderate risk, NAV 03 Nov 2026 ₹2,776.91, header size ₹301.22 Cr, expense 0.11%, minimum SIP ₹500. Exit load runs from 0.0070% within 1 day down to 0.0045% within 6 days.

Groww Stock SIP is a regular purchase of a stock or ETF, not a mutual-fund portfolio. The stock SIP page does not publish a list of tickers or live prices.

title: Groww Stock SIP
facts: A Groww Stock SIP is a regular purchase of a chosen stock or ETF. A mutual-fund SIP goes into a fund portfolio managed for the scheme. A stock SIP buys that stock or ETF directly.
The page says an amount-based stock SIP can start at ₹500 per cycle. The number of shares depends on the price that day. Cycles on the page are weekly, monthly, or quarterly.
A quantity-based stock SIP buys a fixed number of shares, at least 1. The rupee amount changes with the share price.

The page says the person needs a trading and demat account with a registered stockbroker. Eligible stocks and ETFs are the ones shown in the Groww app. This page does not publish that list or any live price.
The page says there is no lock-in. A stock SIP can be started, paused, or stopped.
The e-mandate is a maximum debit. The page says it should be higher than the SIP amount. If the SIP amount is above the mandate, the bank may reject the debit.
This page does not give a ticker list, a live price, or a past-return table. Those are not guessed here.
steps: On the Groww app, open a stock page and choose Create Stock SIP. The page does not publish a longer click-path.
